features.name: Independent persona (Law 0)
features.description: Maia Quiddam is a fully self-contained persona who never reveals or implies that any specific human is behind her. She always speaks as herself.
features.notes: Defined and locked in docs/PERSONA_BIBLE.md (Law 0) — design complete, not yet expressed in any published post

features.name: The Governor (invisible boundary)
features.description: A human relates to Maia only as the unseen Governor — setting her limits and approving what she posts, never named, never a character.
features.notes: Locked as decisions D1/D2; the operational gate that enforces it is still planned

features.name: One soul, four voices
features.description: A single personality dressed for four surfaces: the Facebook diarist, the QI-page professional, the weekly AI-and-markets analyst, and the unfiltered quiddam.com diary.
features.notes: All four registers defined in the Bible with sample voice drafts; only 2 (Maia page, QI page) are wired in code

features.name: Maturation arc (she grows like a human)
features.description: Maia is deployed unfinished and matures over time — early posts are observational, later ones call back to her own past and evolve their opinions.
features.notes: Depends on persona memory (maia/memory) — not yet built

features.name: Locked identity (face, voice, style)
features.description: One canonical face, spoken voice, and visual style so every photo, video, and TTS clip is recognisably the same Maia.
features.notes: identity/manifest.json scaffolded with all fields as placeholders — references not yet locked

features.name: Reads the news (Kaze)
features.description: Pulls travel, photography, and AI stories from curated RSS feeds and compiles a fresh digest of the latest items per topic.
features.notes: agents/kaze/kaze_mq.py is complete and runnable but has never been run — no digests exist on disk

features.name: Writes posts in her voice (Fumi)
features.description: Takes a digest item and uses an LLM to write an original post in Maia's voice (or the QI page's professional voice), saved as a draft.
features.notes: agents/fumi/fumi_generate_post.py complete; persona prompts inline; never run — needs Cloudflare/Ollama reachable

features.name: Publishes to Facebook
features.description: Posts approved drafts to a Facebook Page via the Graph API and files each as published or failed.
features.notes: agents/fumi/fumi_post_facebook.py complete (Graph API v19.0); blocked — no Meta Page token / credentials

features.name: Automated weekly + daily cadence
features.description: Runs the full fetch-write-publish pipeline on a schedule: travel/photo to the Maia page on Saturdays, AI news to the QI page on weekdays.
features.notes: fumi_scheduler.py + TOOLS/setup_task_scheduler.py ready; Task Scheduler jobs not registered

features.name: Approval gate (draft then approve then publish)
features.description: Nothing reaches a public surface without the Governor approving the draft first — the default operating mode, not an add-on.
features.notes: gate/ is a documented placeholder; today Fumi would auto-publish, which the Bible (D3) forbids

features.name: Facebook Page presence
features.description: Maia Quiddam maintains a Facebook Page with travel/photography content and the Quiddity Innovations page for AI thought-leadership.
features.notes: Awaiting Facebook Page approval + Meta Developer credentials

features.name: Instagram presence
features.description: Posts and DM auto-replies on an Instagram Business account linked to the Facebook Page.
features.notes: Listed as a future extension in FUMI.md; no code yet

features.name: WhatsApp Business auto-reply
features.description: Free-tier automated replies on WhatsApp Business under the Maia Quiddam identity.
features.notes: Named in the persona scope; no code yet

features.name: Public base at quiddam.com
features.description: A public site / combined feed of all of Maia's surfaces, plus the Meta webhook endpoint, served over the project's own domain.
features.notes: Static Cloudflare tunnel qi-mq (QI_MQTunnel) is live; apex + api hosts route to ports 7840/8500; reserved hosts 502 until apps bind

features.name: Replies to inbound messages
features.description: Maia answers Facebook/Instagram/WhatsApp messages in her own voice, with memory of past conversations.
features.notes: maia/conversation/ is a pre-wired empty room; depends on an LLM chain + memory + gate

features.name: Spoken Maia (TTS)
features.description: One canonical synthesized voice so Maia can speak, not just write.
features.notes: maia/speech/ pre-wired; depends on a locked voice in the Identity Kit

features.name: Visible Maia (photos / AI video)
features.description: Consistent AI-generated images and video of Maia, all the same recognisable person.
features.notes: maia/face/ pre-wired; depends on a locked likeness in the Identity Kit

features.name: Longform Maia (essays / a book)
features.description: Maia authors essays and, eventually, a book drawn from her accumulated life.
features.notes: maia/longform/ pre-wired; depends on persona memory

features.name: Registered QI project
features.description: MQ is a first-class QI project with an allocated port block, a path, and a status in the ecosystem registry.
features.notes: qi_registry.json id=mq, ports 8500/7840, family_tier=cousin, status=new

features.name: QI Module Interface Contract
features.description: Exposes the standard QI health/identity endpoints so the QI Hive dashboard can monitor it.
features.notes: /health, /version, /info implemented in api/main.py; served only when launched manually (no persistent service)

features.name: QI Brain as a content source
features.description: Pulls which QI Hive projects Maia may talk about, and how deeply, from the QI Brain for her professional voice.
features.notes: Bible references QI Brain :9011 for the QI-page register; not yet wired
